'''Brecourl''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who served on the [[Corellian Council]], the legislative body of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A hotheaded and impetuous man, Councilor Brecourl challenged [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Durand (Corellian)|Durand]] to a duel before the rest of the Council when he became enraged at Durand during a passionate debate about regulations on subsector zoning bypasses. However, Durand won the duel and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Brecourl, who was remembered as the only individual ever to have been killed on the floor of the [[Legislature Building]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brecourl was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Corellian Legislature in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
